title: Jaguars in the Rain
description: A jaguar with detailed rosette patterns leaps dynamically across a muddy jungle stream during a heavy downpour. Its body is captured mid-air with powerful limbs extended, tail raised, and intense gaze directed forward amid splashing water and rain.
prompt: A powerful jaguar with intricate black rosettes on golden fur is captured mid-leap over a muddy jungle stream during a tropical rainstorm. The big cat's body is fully extended with front paws reaching forward, hind legs pushing off, and long tail curled upward. Heavy rain falls from dark stormy clouds with hints of light breaking through, splashing water and mud around its paws in a lush green rainforest setting with fallen logs and dense foliage.
